value.rationale: Geometric coordinate observations of this dimension-variable twisting/stretching model are natural. The exactly dimension-delayed negative autocovariance gives a sharp memory signature while the transfer eigenvalue near one shows lack of uniform geometric mixing as M grows, neither apparent from abstract Bernoulli isomorphism. The entire observable covariance spectrum for all dimensions is provided, rather than a marginal numerical check or known-table recomputation.
